description: Freight Intermodal Facilities is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Caltrans. Its tags are CAOpenData, CalSTA, California Department of Transportation, California State Transportation Agency, Caltrans. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support freight and delivery logistics studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
